resources.name: Open‑source DFT code with PBE exchange‑correlation and PAW or equivalent pseudopotentials (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, CP2K)

access.notes: Pseudopotentials for Zr, Sn, H are available in standard libraries (SSSP, GBRV, PseudoDojo). The agent may use any publicly available DFT package that provides PBE‑level accuracy.

resources.name: Standard crystallographic structures of hcp α‑Zr and fcc δ‑ZrH1.5

access.notes: Lattice parameters and atomic positions for pure α‑Zr and for the δ‑ZrH1.5 phase (hydrogen occupying tetrahedral interstitial sites) are well known from the literature. The agent should construct supercells using standard crystallographic data.
